# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root; it is the single source of project
instructions for every coding agent. The architecture and its invariants are
in `docs/architecture.md`, review guidance in `REVIEW.md`, the multi-agent
workflow in `docs/agent-workflow.md`, task checklists in `.claude/skills/`, and
durable project memory in `memory/`. Custom agents in `.github/agents/` are
generated from `.claude/agents/`; do not edit them directly.
